authority: DESIGN_LOCKS.md fixes 17 classes, 24 tribes, 7 tiers, progression-based unlocks, fast-paced action roguelike, top priorities and 2.5D battle presentation.
scope: Historical draft only. Its sixteen provisional definitions and pending C15 slot are superseded by the complete seventeen-class catalogue in CLASS_ROSTER.json. Do not implement or treat this historical draft as the current roster.
boundaries: Tribe identity includes terrain adaptations and combat traditions. Class defines a combat job. How future technology builds on tribal capabilities must be designed explicitly.
No tier assignments or unlock costs are assigned here. Progression requirements are still to be designed.
Sovereign is the locked Tier 7 identity; this draft does not turn it into an eighteenth class.
Pals are surviving trusted inner-circle people and upgraders; they are not a creature-command system. Combat participation remains undecided.
The shared-system labels below describe implementation opportunities, not proof that those systems already work.
The existing eight enum names are retained as candidates to reduce unnecessary migration; new signatures still require implementation review.
Basic locomotion may be shared within compatible body plans. Each signature has animation, effects and readability work.
Exact values, cooldowns, targeting rules, input control and balance are not fixed by this dataset.

classes.name: Warden
classes.job: Keep a vulnerable ally alive and hold contested ground.

signature.name: Guard
signature.description: Temporarily reduce incoming damage for a nearby chosen ally while staying close enough to protect them.

classes.weakness: Limited reach and pursuit; guarding ties the Warden to the protected ally.

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.job: Start an engagement and open a route through enemy pressure.

signature.name: Breakthrough
signature.description: Make a short committed charge and stagger the first enemy struck.

classes.weakness: A missed or poorly aimed charge leaves the Vanguard exposed.

classes.name: Duelist
classes.job: Win a sustained one-on-one fight through timing.

signature.name: Riposte
signature.description: Use a brief guard window to counter one incoming strike.

classes.weakness: Multiple attackers overwhelm the single-strike defence.

classes.name: Berserker

signature.name: Bloodrush
signature.description: Temporarily increase melee damage at the cost of reduced defence.

classes.weakness: Taking punishment to maintain pressure can quickly become fatal.

classes.name: Marksman
classes.job: Remove a dangerous single target from a safe distance.

signature.name: Aimed Shot
signature.description: Commit to a brief aim before delivering a powerful single-target shot.

classes.weakness: Close pressure interrupts the opportunity to aim.

classes.name: Skirmisher

signature.name: Running Shot
signature.description: Pair a light ranged attack with a short reposition.

classes.weakness: Lower single-hit damage and a need for open escape space.

classes.name: Artillerist

signature.name: Bombard
signature.description: Launch a delayed explosive at a chosen ground position.

classes.weakness: Slow attacks are easy for mobile enemies to leave behind.

classes.name: Shadow
classes.job: Reach a priority target through flanking.

signature.name: Ambush
signature.description: Deliver a stronger opening strike from a flank, then seek an exit.

classes.weakness: Low staying power if caught in a prolonged frontal fight.

classes.name: Trapper
classes.job: Control the route an enemy is about to use.

signature.name: Snare
signature.description: Place a trap that arms briefly and restrains the next enemy entering it.

classes.weakness: Needs anticipation; a trap on an unused route contributes nothing.

classes.name: Investigator
classes.job: Help the squad defeat a particularly dangerous enemy.

signature.name: Expose
signature.description: Study one target, reveal a relevant defence and temporarily make that target more vulnerable to allied attacks.

classes.weakness: Analysis costs time and contributes little against enemies that die immediately.

classes.name: Occultist
classes.job: Recover an ally's health during combat.

signature.name: Mend
signature.description: Channel a short heal into one ally at a personal sanity cost.

classes.weakness: Interruption and repeated healing put the Occultist at risk.

classes.name: Herald

signature.name: Rally
signature.description: Restore sanity to allies within a short radius.

classes.weakness: Low damage contribution and limited reach when the squad splits apart.

classes.name: Alchemist
classes.job: Reduce pressure by weakening enemies in a small area.

signature.name: Reagent
signature.description: Throw a limited-charge vial that creates a short-lived cloud reducing enemy damage.

classes.weakness: Charges are limited and mobile enemies can leave the cloud.

classes.name: Engineer
classes.job: Establish sustained pressure at a chosen position.

signature.name: Sentry
signature.description: Deploy one short-lived stationary sentry that attacks nearby enemies.

classes.weakness: Loses value when the fight moves away; the sentry can be destroyed.

classes.change_note: The Beastwarden definition was withdrawn after the owner clarified Pals are surviving trusted people and upgraders. No replacement class is invented by this correction; the total of 17 class slots remains fixed.

classes.name: Binder
classes.job: Break enemy positioning by pulling a target out of place.

signature.name: Tether
signature.description: Use a visible tether to pull one eligible enemy toward the Binder.

classes.weakness: Short effective reach; anchored or resistant enemies may resist displacement.

classes.name: Vessel
classes.job: Trade mental stability for a short burst of offensive power.

signature.name: Overload
signature.description: Spend personal sanity to empower attacks for a short duration.

classes.weakness: Repeated use approaches a mental break and requires a recovery window.
classes.change_note: Proposed active redesign of the earlier survival/Mercy class. Retaining or replacing the old Mercy behaviour is not approved by this draft.

unresolved_rules: Guard damage reduction and stacking; who can be protected and within what range.
Movement collision and charge interruption; no movement skill may leave the valid battlefield.
Parryable attacks, riposte timing and outcomes for simultaneous hits.
Friendly-fire policy for explosives, traps and reagent clouds.
Trap arming time and placement limits; summon/sentry lifespan and replacement rules.
Expose information available in the codex versus combat-only vulnerability effects.
Healing, sanity costs, zero-resource behaviour and interruption refunds.
Alchemist charge replenishment and its relationship to shared consumable items.
Displacement resistance for bosses and anchored enemies, including a readable failed-tether outcome.
Unlock persistence, progression triggers, connections to tiers and which tribes field which classes.
Replace the withdrawn C15 definition with a distinct combat role grounded in the tribal science-fiction premise.
Define how Pal-led technology upgrades interact with tribal traits, class roles and items without assuming each Pal is a recruitable combat class.
Review the remaining sixteen provisional class definitions for science-fiction fit; none became approved through this correction.
review_criteria: Each class must offer a combat decision or preferred situation distinct from the others.
An early-unlocked class must remain useful in later tiers; later unlocks should broaden choices rather than automatically replace it.
A defining action must be readable at the intended 2.5D battle scale before expanding its upgrades.
The final approved dataset must contain exactly 17 unique class IDs.
verification: Seventeen unique reserved IDs; sixteen provisional definitions and one explicit pending replacement. No gameplay, balance, animation or runtime validation.

owner_context.pals: Trusted people in the main character's inner circle who survive the opening defeat with the protagonist and serve as upgraders.
owner_context.technology: Class and tribe development must account for advanced science-fiction technology and the Pals' upgrader role.
owner_context.undecided: Pal names, specialties, count, location, participation in combat and detailed upgrade rules are not defined here.
